record_kind: Closed normative field/value record; not an executable operational plan or a JSON-Schema validator.

inheritance.all_other_shapes: Exactly the frozen /0.1.3 shapes and P05/P07/P11/P13/P16/P17 predicates; no added approval, flags, commands, caller limits or resources.
inheritance.preserved_plan_identity: Never relabel or mutate the actual /0.1.4 schema or externally authenticated plan descriptor.

rtld_paths.components_order: Strict ascending ASCII path order; exact nine paths, kinds and targets below; no duplicates or extra rows.

identity.timestamps: Signed integer nanoseconds; no equality/positivity inferred from historical timestamps.
identity.source: Actual later operational-plan observation only; this design supplies no current identities.
identity.comparison: Exact full tuple versus named nofollow stat and opened fstat before/after, across two reanchored passes and every subsequent recheck.

rtld_paths.absence_semantics: Only ENOENT for first_missing basename under authenticated physical parent. Recompose original candidate through the fixed alias trace and exact remaining suffix; never inspect suffix after first missing. No dangling-link/ENOTDIR/EACCES equivalence.

candidate_contract.only_new_interpretation: For /0.1.4 absent rows, retain exact lexical parent equality and replace parent-is-directory predicate with the corresponding authenticated physical first-missing proof.
candidate_contract.literal_equality: One exact existing literal RTLDLIST extraction, with unchanged ASCII split; compare complete ordered row paths. Do not sort, omit, insert or rewrite candidates.
error_precedence: Validate candidate container/path types; existing duplicate path check: CHI-INSPECTOR / Duplicate RTLD candidate.
Full ordered literal-list mismatch: CHI-UNSUPPORTED / Inspector RTLDLIST is not the exact reviewed literal list.
Fixed new-profile states/row shapes/parent/binding/witness relations, then finite proof and admitted result use.
candidate_contract.closure_equality: File candidate binding equals libc_plt.loader binding, host/runtime canonical file binding and unique loader image descriptor; actual interpreter/role relationships remain inherited. Absent candidates have no HOST file/image/role entries.

finite_walk.root_argument: No alternate operational root, mount namespace or cwd binding is accepted.
forbidden: absolute symlink target in this new model
root escape or root-clamping as permission
special files or symlinks at fixed physical directory/file entries
using final canonical equality alone as ancestry proof
observations: For one basename relative to held physical parent: nofollow stat, open nofollow O_PATH (O_DIRECTORY where required), fstat equality.
For a symlink: os.readlink(b"", dir_fd=link_fd), exact complete bytes; fstat and named-entry nofollow stat afterward.
Verify each physical directory parent transition and recheck every retained named route.
Authenticate each expected single-component absence with ENOENT; repeat after parent/root route verification.
Close all first-pass descriptors; perform second complete fresh-root pass; exact equality with plan and first pass.
finite_walk.capability_policy: Fail closed without same-semantics Linux/Python facilities. No ctypes/native helper, unchecked realpath fallback or new process.

private_seams.alias: _check_rtld_alias_trace: exact x86-64 path/edges only; unrelated /lib cannot affect result.
private_seams.absence: _check_rtld_absence_trace: exact i386 and x32 witnesses only.
private_seams.aggregate: _check_rtld_paths path/order composition is separately testable with frozen inert bindings; every operational caller must apply the fixed real-loader pin before using its alias result. A synthetic aggregate cannot be an eligible plan.
private_seams.tests: Logical fixture mappings/injected observations stay in labelled private test adapters, never operational plan fields.

terminal_file_read.path_argument: One basename relative to held canonical physical parent descriptor.
terminal_file_read.before: Regular file; full fstat equals held O_PATH terminal and named nofollow identity.
terminal_file_read.during: Callback-bounded SHA-256 stream; expected size plus one detection byte maximum; no execution or mapping.
terminal_file_read.after: Exact length/digest/mode and full before/after fstat/named identity equality; retain observed drift; close once.
terminal_file_read.primitive_binding: Independently frozen synthetic binding allowed only at private test seam.
terminal_file_read.operational_binding: Exact fixed loader pin and all agreed actual plan descriptors mandatory before operational alias use; no override.
terminal_file_read.existing_bound_checks: Every inherited canonical _bound check remains required.

bounds.callbacks: Before each new observation and at final acceptance, within the existing clock; no new callback on old routes.
bounds.legacy_limits: No change, including legacy 40-link rule, static_ms 60000, command_ms 5000, active_work_ms 3000, cleanup_ms 2000, publication_ms 30000 and source budgets.
bounds.transient_descriptor_slot: One temporary parent/reanchor or readable terminal descriptor; never overlap these uses beyond ten total.

path_guard_relations.present_agreement: Map identity[0,1,2] to device,inode,permission mode; exact kind and raw target. Additional full identity fields remain in rtld_paths.
path_guard_relations.exclusion_authority: Only after successful complete /0.1.4 finite proof; every excluded name remains represented by typed results. _existing_chain is unchanged.

snapshot.construction: Fresh full finite proof at snapshot creation; no generic FileNotFoundError/exists inference for excluded names.
snapshot.rechecks: Fresh complete proof at every complete recheck; exact snapshot comparison; final launch proof after ordinary checks under original command clock.
snapshot.launch_failure: Explicit .4-only CHI-DRIFT wrapper with underlying path refusal; snapshot inequality first creates CHI-PATH/RP-NAMESPACE. Leave callback/clock PROCESS/timeout and old routes unchanged.

failure_contract.errno_type: actual integer OS errno or null, never inferred from a high-level exists result

rules.meaning: Wrong new pair; old routes retain old diagnostics.
Unknown/missing keys, fields, ordering, types or fixed model values.

rules.reason: RTLD candidate differs from fixed path model
rules.meaning: State/parent/binding-map disagreement after exact list equality.

rules.reason: RTLD path component identity or type differs
rules.meaning: Wrong component kind or full seven-field identity; inconsistent P07 guard.
The precise expected missing basename exists, or nearest parent/witness differs.
OS error other than accepted single-component ENOENT; include actual errno/cause.

rules.reason: Required RTLD no-follow capability is unavailable
rules.meaning: No O_PATH/O_NOFOLLOW/O_CLOEXEC/O_DIRECTORY, dir_fd, nofollow stat or empty-path symlink read; no fallback.
An observed raw target or transition is outside the finite allowlist.

rules.reason: Excessive or circular RTLD alias chain
rules.meaning: Repeated symlink entry identity or excess semantic symlink expansion count. OS-reported ELOOP remains RP-IO / CHI-PATH.
Input/intermediate bound or finite transition/resource bound exceeded.

rules.reason: RTLD named route changed during observation
rules.meaning: Root-reanchored disagreement, named-entry/descriptor disagreement, private claimed-terminal-path inequality (N16), or typed snapshot mismatch. Claimed canonical equality uses CHI-PATH even when another spelling reaches the same inode.
No success after close failure; retain primary and cleanup evidence.

rules.reason: RTLD terminal file changed or binding differs
rules.meaning: Bounded terminal read length/digest/mode or before/after full readable/named identity mismatch; retain expected and actual identities/bindings.

ordered_observation_faults: Shape and bounded input checks before any new trace observation.

Validate candidate container/path types and reject duplicates; then exact full literal-list equality; only then fixed states/row shapes/parent/file/witness relations and trace use. Never derive lookup authority from an unlisted candidate.
Per entry: nofollow identity/type then opened identity; only then raw symlink target allowlist.
Expected absence accepts only precise ENOENT; any existing entry refuses.
Pass/namespace comparisons before final callback and success.
failure_contract.callback: Same-object private callback propagation when all owned descriptors close successfully; enclosing existing timeout/cause behavior remains.
failure_contract.cleanup: Close every owned descriptor exactly once; any close error blocks success and retains primary and cleanup evidence.
failure_contract.recheck_wrapper: Existing CHI-DRIFT outer failure/cause and state; no suppression of an actual prior-start receipt or unknown starts.
failure_contract.unsupported_loop_errno: OS ELOOP is RP-IO / CHI-PATH with actual errno/cause, never absence; only detected unapproved/repeated semantic edges use CHI-UNSUPPORTED.
failure_contract.path_values: One of snapshot.legacy_snapshot_exclusions (the fourteen fixed names), or null for unavailable/malformed/unapproved input; no arbitrary path echo.

observations.identity: The seven integer identity fields, or null when unavailable; evidence may contain a differing actual file type.
observations.binding: Closed ordinary {sha256,size_bytes,mode}, or null; observed bindings only after a complete stream read, never a partial-prefix digest.
observations.target: target_fingerprint below or null; fingerprints describe bytes actually read or exact expected bytes, not normalized targets.
observations.terminal_drift: Retain expected/opened_before/opened_after/named_after identities; expected and observed complete bindings populate those same rows when available.
observations.namespace_drift: Retain first_pass and second_pass or the disagreeing named/opened observations.

target_fingerprint.size_bytes: Actual nonnegative integer byte count, excluding Boolean.
target_fingerprint.sha256: Exactly 64 lowercase hex characters: SHA-256 of the complete actual or expected raw target bytes.
target_fingerprint.prefix_hex: Exactly the lowercase hex of the first min(size_bytes,128) bytes, even length at most 256 characters; explicitly a prefix, not the full target.

fault_summary.errno: Actual integer errno excluding Boolean, or null when absent; never inferred.
fault_summary.operation: Listed failure_contract operation value or null.
fault_summary.message: First at most 512 Unicode characters of actual exception message.
fault_summary.message_truncated: Boolean: true precisely when message was shortened; this is a diagnostic summary, while original primary cause remains attached unchanged.

evidence.primary: fault_summary or null when no prior exception object exists (for example, an identity-comparison refusal).

cleanup.item: fault_summary for each actually failed close, in close-attempt order; [] when all closes succeeded.
cleanup.once_only: One close attempt per acquired descriptor; never retry close on a potentially reused descriptor.

evidence.simultaneous_faults: Generate RP-CLEANUP with original primary as cause and summaries of primary plus every failed close; if no primary, retain first cleanup exception as cause. Other close faults remain in cleanup.
evidence.callback_boundary: When descriptor cleanup succeeds, propagate the same callback object without a fabricated path error. Existing enclosing callback/timeout behavior remains. The evidence shape applies to new path-generated HostInspectionError instances, not to relabelling a propagated callback.
evidence.serialization_failure: Existing evidence finalization failed/unknown rules apply; no success if required failure evidence cannot be retained. No public top-level fields change.

launch_wrapper.reason: RTLD path changed immediately before launch
launch_wrapper.cause: The original new path-generated proof refusal, or a generated CHI-PATH/RP-NAMESPACE for snapshot inequality, including its details and original state.
launch_wrapper.exception_scope: Wrap only new path-generated proof/snapshot refusals. Callback/clock faults retain existing PROCESS/timeout handling; older launch routes are unchanged.
launch_wrapper.source_need: Frozen _launch_check currently re-raises HostInspectionError, so this new-profile wrapper must be explicit.

independent_controls.author_claim: All later implementation obligations; none executed in P24. Exact independent crosswalk binds candidate hashes.
independent_controls.F09: Mocked prior-start accounting; no actual target execution implied.
